scenario.title: Bus Booking App – Book Bus Ticket
scenario.description:
A registered user searches for buses between two cities for a selected travel date, chooses a bus, selects an available seat, enters passenger details, makes the payment, and verifies the booking confirmation.

Features to test
Feature	What to verify
Login	Valid/invalid credentials
Bus Search	Source, destination, travel date
Bus Selection	Bus details, timing, fare
Seat Selection	Available/occupied seats
Passenger Details	Name, age, gender, contact details
Payment	Successful/failed payment
Booking Confirmation	Ticket, seat, PNR/booking ID

reference_cases.title: Successful bus booking with valid details and payment
reference_cases.preconditions: User is registered with email: testuser@example.com, password: Test@1234
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter email and password
3. Click Login
4. Enter source city, destination city, and travel date
5. Click Search
6. Select a bus from results
7. Click on an available seat
8. Enter passenger name, age, gender, and contact number
9. Proceed to payment
10. Enter card details and complete payment
11. Verify booking confirmation page
reference_cases.test_data: email = testuser@example.com; password = Test@1234; source = Mumbai; destination = Pune; travel_date = 2024-02-15; bus = Volvo AC Sleeper 9:00 AM; seat = 12A; passenger_name = Rajesh Kumar; age = 32; gender = Male; contact = 9876543210; card_number = 4111111111111111; cvv = 123; expiry = 12/25
reference_cases.expected_result: Booking confirmation page displays with PNR number, passenger name (Rajesh Kumar), seat number (12A), bus details (Volvo AC Sleeper 9:00 AM), travel date (2024-02-15), route (Mumbai to Pune), and booking status as Confirmed

reference_cases.title: Login fails with incorrect password
reference_cases.preconditions: User account exists with email: testuser@example.com
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid email and incorrect password
3. Click Login
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.' User remains on login page

reference_cases.title: Search returns no results for invalid route
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter source and destination cities that have no bus service
2. Select travel date
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: Message displayed: 'No buses available for this route on the selected date.' Search results section is empty

reference_cases.title: Cannot select already occupied seat
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has searched for buses. Seat 15B is already booked
reference_cases.steps:
1. Select a bus from search results
2. Attempt to click on seat 15B which shows as occupied/booked
reference_cases.test_data: bus = Scania Multi-Axle 11:30 PM; seat = 15B (status: occupied)
reference_cases.expected_result: Seat 15B is not selectable (grayed out or disabled). No action occurs on click. Tooltip or message shows 'Seat already booked'

reference_cases.title: Search with past date is rejected
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Current date is 2024-02-10
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter source and destination
2. Select a past date from date picker
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: Error message: 'Please select a current or future date.' Search is not executed

reference_cases.title: Passenger age at minimum boundary (1 year)
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter passenger details with age = 1
2. Fill other mandatory fields
3. Proceed to payment
reference_cases.test_data: passenger_name = Baby Singh; age = 1; gender = Male; contact = 9123456789
reference_cases.expected_result: Form accepts age value of 1. User proceeds to payment page without errors

reference_cases.title: Passenger age at maximum boundary (120 years)
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter passenger details with age = 120
2. Fill other mandatory fields
3. Proceed to payment
reference_cases.test_data: passenger_name = Elder Person; age = 120; gender = Female; contact = 9234567890
reference_cases.expected_result: Form accepts age value of 120. User proceeds to payment page without errors

reference_cases.title: Invalid passenger age rejected (0 or negative)
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter passenger details with age = 0
2. Fill other mandatory fields
3. Attempt to proceed
reference_cases.test_data: passenger_name = Test User; age = 0; gender = Male; contact = 9345678901
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error: 'Age must be between 1 and 120.' Cannot proceed to payment

reference_cases.title: Payment fails with insufficient card balance
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected, passenger details entered. Card has balance less than ticket fare
reference_cases.steps:
1. Proceed to payment page
2. Enter card details with insufficient balance
3. Click Pay Now
reference_cases.expected_result: Payment fails. Error message: 'Payment declined due to insufficient funds.' Booking is not confirmed. User remains on payment page

reference_cases.title: Invalid contact number format rejected
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter passenger name, age, gender
2. Enter contact number with less than 10 digits
3. Attempt to proceed to payment
reference_cases.test_data: passenger_name = Amit Sharma; age = 28; gender = Male; contact = 98765
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error: 'Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.' Cannot proceed to payment

reference_cases.title: Search for same day travel (today's date)
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in. Current date and time is 2024-02-10 08:00 AM
reference_cases.steps:
1. Enter source and destination
2. Select today's date
3. Click Search
reference_cases.expected_result: Search results display buses departing after current time (after 08:00 AM). Buses with departure time before 08:00 AM are not shown

reference_cases.title: Mandatory passenger fields validation
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in, bus and seat selected
reference_cases.steps:
1. Leave passenger name field empty
2. Fill age, gender, and contact
3. Attempt to proceed to payment
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error: 'Passenger name is required.' Cannot proceed to payment. Name field is highlighted

helpers.name: setup
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Resets app to initial state: logged out, on Login Page, no visible message, all data reset to starting data (removes all bookings created during tests, resets seat occupancy to initial state)

helpers.name: teardown
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If booking_id is provided and exists, deletes that booking and frees its seat. If booking_id is None, does nothing. Always succeeds silently

helpers.name: current_page
helpers.returns: String: name of current page
helpers.behaviour: Returns the exact page name from the pages list that user is currently on

helpers.name: visible_message
helpers.returns: String: current message shown to user, or empty string if none
helpers.behaviour: Returns the current error/success/info message displayed on screen, or '' if no message is shown

helpers.name: navigate_to_login
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Navigates to Login Page. Clears any visible message

helpers.name: login
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if login successful, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Attempts to log in with provided credentials. If email and password match a user account, logs in, navigates to Search Page, clears message, returns true. If credentials invalid, sets message 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.', stays on Login Page, returns false

helpers.name: search_buses
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if search executed, false if validation failed
helpers.behaviour: Must be logged in. Validates travel_date is not before current date (2024-02-10). If past date, sets message 'Please select a current or future date.', returns false. Otherwise searches for buses matching route and date. If found, navigates to Search Results Page, clears message, returns true. If no buses found, sets message 'No buses available for this route on the selected date.', stays on Search Page, returns false

helpers.name: get_search_results
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{bus_id, name, route, departure, arrival, fare}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Must be on Search Results Page. Returns list of buses from last search. If searching for today's date (2024-02-10), filters out buses with departure time before current time (08:00). Returns empty list if no results

helpers.name: select_bus
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if bus selected, false if not found
helpers.behaviour: Must be on Search Results Page. Finds bus by exact name match in current search results. If found, navigates to Seat Selection Page, clears message, returns true. If not found, sets message 'Bus not found in search results.', returns false

helpers.name: get_seat_map
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{seat_number, status}, ...] where status is 'available' or 'occupied'
helpers.behaviour: Must be on Seat Selection Page. Returns all seats for selected bus with their current status for the searched travel date. Status is 'occupied' if seat is pre-booked or booked during test session for that date

helpers.name: select_seat
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if seat selected, false if occupied or invalid
helpers.behaviour: Must be on Seat Selection Page. If seat is occupied, sets message 'Seat already booked', returns false. If seat is available, selects it, navigates to Passenger Details Page, clears message, returns true. If seat doesn't exist, sets message 'Invalid seat number.', returns false

helpers.name: enter_passenger_details
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if details valid and accepted, false if validation failed
helpers.behaviour: Must be on Passenger Details Page. Validates: passenger_name not empty (error: 'Passenger name is required.'), age between 1 and 120 inclusive (error: 'Age must be between 1 and 120.'), contact is exactly 10 digits (error: 'Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.'). If any validation fails, sets error message, stays on page, returns false. If all valid, stores details, navigates to Payment Page, clears message, returns true

helpers.name: make_payment
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if payment successful, false if failed
helpers.behaviour: Must be on Payment Page. Checks if card exists and has sufficient balance for ticket fare. If card not found or balance insufficient, sets message 'Payment declined due to insufficient funds.', stays on Payment Page, returns false. If payment succeeds, creates booking with status 'Confirmed', generates PNR (format: PNR + 10 digits), marks seat as occupied, navigates to Booking Confirmation Page, clears message, returns true

helpers.name: get_booking_confirmation
helpers.returns: Object: {pnr, passenger_name, seat_number, bus_name, travel_date, route, status} or None
helpers.behaviour: Must be on Booking Confirmation Page. Returns details of the most recently completed booking, or None if no booking exists

helpers.name: api_login
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, user_email} or {ok: false, error: 'Invalid email or password. Please try again.'}
helpers.behaviour: Validates credentials against user accounts. If valid, returns success with user email. If invalid, returns error. Does not change current page or message

helpers.name: api_search_buses
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, buses: [{bus_id, name, route, departure, arrival, fare}, ...]} or {ok: false, error: '...'}
helpers.behaviour: Validates travel_date is not before 2024-02-10. If past, returns {ok: false, error: 'Please select a current or future date.'}. Searches for buses matching route. If searching for 2024-02-10, filters buses departing before 08:00. If no buses found, returns {ok: false, error: 'No buses available for this route on the selected date.'}. Otherwise returns {ok: true, buses: [...]}

helpers.name: api_get_seats
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, seats: [{seat_number, status}, ...]} or {ok: false, error: '...'}
helpers.behaviour: Returns all seats for the bus with their status for the given date. Status is 'available' or 'occupied'. If bus_id invalid, returns {ok: false, error: 'Bus not found.'}

helpers.name: api_book_ticket
helpers.returns: Object: {ok: true, booking: {pnr, passenger_name, seat_number, bus_name, travel_date, route, status, fare}} or {ok: false, error: '...'}
helpers.behaviour: Validates all inputs: passenger_name not empty, age 1-120, contact 10 digits, seat available, card valid with sufficient balance. If any validation fails, returns {ok: false, error: '...'}. If seat occupied: 'Seat already booked'. If name empty: 'Passenger name is required.'. If age invalid: 'Age must be between 1 and 120.'. If contact invalid: 'Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.'. If payment fails: 'Payment declined due to insufficient funds.'. If all valid, creates booking, marks seat occupied, returns {ok: true, booking: {...}}

helpers.name: db_get_user
helpers.returns: Object: {email, password, name} or None if not found
helpers.behaviour: Returns user record by email, or None if doesn't exist

helpers.name: db_get_buses
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{bus_id, name, route, departure, arrival, fare, total_seats}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns all buses matching the route (case-insensitive match on source and destination). Returns empty list if no matches

helpers.name: db_get_seat_status
helpers.returns: String: 'available' or 'occupied'
helpers.behaviour: Returns current status of the seat for the given bus and date. Checks both pre-booked seats and bookings created during test session

helpers.name: db_get_booking
helpers.returns: Object: {pnr, bus_id, travel_date, seat_number, passenger_name, age, gender, contact, fare, status} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns booking record by PNR, or None if not found

helpers.name: db_get_all_bookings
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{pnr, bus_id, travel_date, seat_number, passenger_name, age, gender, contact, fare, status}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns all bookings in the system. Used for verification and cleanup

helpers.name: db_delete_booking
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if deleted, false if not found
helpers.behaviour: Deletes booking by PNR and frees the seat. Returns true if booking existed and was deleted, false if PNR not found

rules: Users must be logged in to search for buses, select seats, or make bookings
Travel date must be current date (2024-02-10) or future date; past dates are rejected
When searching for today's date (2024-02-10), only buses departing after current time (08:00) are shown
Passenger name is mandatory and cannot be empty
Passenger age must be between 1 and 120 (inclusive)
Contact number must be exactly 10 digits
Seats marked as occupied cannot be selected
Payment requires card to exist and have balance >= ticket fare
Successful payment creates booking with status 'Confirmed' and generates unique PNR
PNR format: PNR followed by 10 digits (e.g., PNR1234567890)
Each booking occupies exactly one seat on one bus for one date
Failed validations or payments do not create bookings or change seat status

Card CVV and expiry validation: Only card number and balance are checked
Seat layout visualization: Seats returned as list with status, no graphical layout
Multiple passengers per booking: Each booking is for one passenger only
Booking cancellation: No cancel feature; use teardown to remove test bookings
User registration: Only pre-existing test account available
